user.title: Private Forgejo repository
user.description: Use the SSH clone URL of a private repository dedicated to backups.

verify.title: Verify the server and authorize the key
verify.description:
Compare one of the detected fingerprints `{fingerprint}` with a trusted value from your server administrator. Enter that trusted value below. Add the following public key to the dedicated repository as a deploy key with write access.

`{public_key}`

error.invalid_url: Use an SSH URL such as ssh://git@forgejo.example.org:2222/team/backups.git.
error.cannot_connect: Could not identify the SSH server or generate the key.
error.fingerprint_mismatch: The trusted fingerprint does not match.
error.cannot_write: Could not access the repository with this deploy key. Check the URL and write access.

init.title: Direct web download
init.description: Use the HTTPS URL of the private backup repository and a token restricted to that repository with write:repository. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token for the same URL. Clear the URL to disable publishing attachments.

error.invalid_web_url: Use the HTTPS URL of the same backup repository.
error.release_access: The token must have write access to the private backup repository.
